title: Watch the John Lewis Christmas ad 2017

segments.description: Medium establishing shot of a young boy lying awake in his cozy bedroom at night [[00:00](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=0)].
Close-up action shot of the boy looking under his bed and discovering a large, furry friendly monster [[00:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=11)].
Medium shot of the boy writing signs and trying to keep the noisy monster awake during the day [[00:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=19)].
Medium action shot of the boy and the large monster playing games and having fun together in the bedroom at night [[00:30](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=30)].
Medium close-up shot of the exhausted boy struggling to stay awake at school and during daytime activities due to lack of sleep [[00:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=47)].
Medium shot of the monster noticing the boy's fatigue and deciding to play a quiet game with a light-up toy instead [[01:10](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=70)].
Medium close-up shot of Christmas morning arriving as the boy opens a mysterious, bulky wrapped gift [[01:28](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=88)].

Wide tabletop shot revealing the magical night-light gift that lets the boy hear and remember his furry friend anytime, concluding the holiday commercial [[01:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sa5dzQhvbiI&t=107)].
